reference_target.definition: median across Development carriers of P(abs(slope_t)<=2.0) on 5m_offset_0
reference_target.role: SIDEWAYS occupancy target only; not a trading target

interval_specific_t1_fit.candidate_thresholds: sorted unique absolute Development slope_t values pooled across the two carriers within each interval anchor profile, plus 0
interval_specific_t1_fit.objective: minimize absolute difference between carrier-median SIDEWAYS occupancy at candidate T1 and the 5m reference target

robust_normalization_fit.primary_scale: median across Development carriers of each carrier median(abs(slope_t)) within interval anchor

sensitivity_scales.MAD_about_median: median across carriers of median(abs(slope_t - median_carrier_slope_t))
sensitivity_scales.abs_slope_t_q75: median across carriers of carrier q75(abs(slope_t))
